description: AUTHSRV: SERVE THE DAY'S CARD AND ATM AUTHORIZATIONS
RUNS FOR THE WHOLE ONLINE DAY, AS A TRANSACTION MONITOR DOES.
READS ONE AUTHORIZATION REQUEST AT A TIME FROM SYSIN, READS
THE CARD AND ITS ACCOUNT FROM THE ONLINE FILES, AND FOR A
REVERSAL THE HOLD, CALLS THE PROGRAM FOR THE REQUEST, AND
WRITES THE RESPONSE TO SYSOUT. WHEN A REQUEST IS APPROVED IT
REWRITES THE ACCOUNT AND THE CARD AND WRITES OR REWRITES THE
HOLD. THE CALLED PROGRAMS DECIDE; ONLY AUTHSRV OPENS FILES, SO
THAT EACH FILE HAS ONE READER AND WRITER. ENDS WITH THE
REQUESTS, WHEN THE BATCH WINDOW OPENS, AND REPORTS THE DAY.
HOLD NUMBERS, THE AUTHORIZATION CODES, NUMBER THE DAY'S HOLDS
FROM 1, AND GO ON FROM THE HIGHEST IN THE HOLD FILE WHEN THE
SERVER IS STARTED AGAIN DURING THE DAY.

identification.text: FIRST BANK OF PANGAEA, DATA CENTER.

records.name: BANK-CONTROL-RECORD
records.description: BANKCTL: BANK CONTROL RECORD, ONE PER FILE THE BUSINESS DATE THE BATCH RUNS FOR, NEVER THE CLOCK.

records.name: ACCT-ONLINE-RECORD
records.description: ACCTONL: ONLINE ACCOUNT RECORD, 100 BYTES INDEXED BY ACCOUNT NUMBER. LOADED FROM THE MASTER EACH NIGHT BY ACCTLOAD; DURING THE DAY THE AUTHORIZATIONS ADD WHAT THEY APPROVE TO THE HOLDS, AND THE AVAILABLE BALANCE IS THE BALANCE PLUS THE OVERDRAFT LIMIT LESS THE HOLDS. MODIFICATION HISTORY DATE       BY  CHANGE 2003-05-19 MV  CR-0342 ORIGINAL VERSION.

fields.name: AO-BALANCE
fields.description: THE BALANCE AT THE END OF THE BUSINESS DAY IT WAS LOADED ON.

records.name: CARD-RECORD
records.description: CARDREC: CARD RECORD, 80 BYTES THE CARD MASTER, IN CARD NUMBER ORDER, AND THE ONLINE CARD FILE LOADED FROM IT EACH NIGHT, INDEXED BY CARD NUMBER. A CARD IS VALID TO THE END OF ITS EXPIRY MONTH. THE AUTHORIZATIONS KEEP THE TOTALS OF THE DAY OF CR-TOTALS-DATE, AND THE ATM WITHDRAWALS OF ITS MONTH, AND START THEM OVER ON A NEW DAY. MODIFICATION HISTORY DATE       BY  CHANGE 2003-05-19 MV  CR-0342 ORIGINAL VERSION.

records.name: HOLD-RECORD
records.description: HOLDREC: HOLD RECORD, 100 BYTES AN AMOUNT AUTHORIZED ONLINE AND NOT YET POSTED: A CARD PURCHASE OR AN ATM WITHDRAWAL AND ITS FEE. INDEXED BY ACCOUNT AND HOLD NUMBER, THE AUTHORIZATION CODE, WHICH NUMBERS THE DAY'S HOLDS FROM 1. A REVERSED PURCHASE STAYS, MARKED. MODIFICATION HISTORY DATE       BY  CHANGE 2003-05-19 MV  CR-0342 ORIGINAL VERSION. 2007-02-05 MV  CR-0415 ATM FEE.

records.name: AUTH-REQUEST
records.description: AUTHMSG: AUTHORIZATION REQUEST, 80 BYTES, AND RESPONSE, 90 A CARD TERMINAL OR ATM SENDS A REQUEST FOR A CARD: A PURCHASE, THE REVERSAL OF ONE BY ITS AUTHORIZATION CODE, A CASH WITHDRAWAL OR A BALANCE ENQUIRY. THE RESPONSE GIVES THE RESULT, AND WHEN APPROVED THE AUTHORIZATION CODE, THE AMOUNT HELD AND THE FEE, AND THE ACCOUNT'S BALANCE AND AVAILABLE BALANCE AFTERWARDS. MODIFICATION HISTORY DATE       BY  CHANGE 2003-05-19 MV  CR-0342 ORIGINAL VERSION. 2007-02-05 MV  CR-0415 FEE IN THE RESPONSE.

paragraphs.name: 0000-MAIN
paragraphs.description: SERVE REQUESTS UNTIL THERE ARE NO MORE, THEN REPORT.

paragraphs.name: 1000-INITIALIZE
paragraphs.description: OPEN THE FILES, READ THE BUSINESS DATE AND FIND THE LAST HOLD NUMBER GIVEN TODAY.

paragraphs.name: 1100-FIND-LAST-HOLD
paragraphs.description: READ THROUGH THE HOLDS FOR THE HIGHEST HOLD NUMBER.

paragraphs.name: 2000-SERVE-REQUEST
paragraphs.description: READ THE NEXT REQUEST, AND ANSWER IT.

paragraphs.name: 2100-AUTHORIZE
paragraphs.description: FIND THE RECORDS THE REQUEST IS ABOUT, CALL THE PROGRAM FOR IT, AND KEEP WHAT IT CHANGED IF IT APPROVED.

paragraphs.name: 2200-READ-CARD-AND-ACCOUNT
paragraphs.description: READ THE CARD, AND THE ACCOUNT IT DRAWS ON.

paragraphs.name: 2300-READ-HOLD
paragraphs.description: READ THE HOLD OF THE AUTHORIZATION TO REVERSE.

paragraphs.name: 2400-SAVE-CHANGES
paragraphs.description: REWRITE THE ACCOUNT AND THE CARD, AND WRITE A NEW HOLD UNDER THE NEXT HOLD NUMBER OR REWRITE THE REVERSED ONE.

paragraphs.name: 9900-ABORT
paragraphs.description: STOP THE RUN WITH RETURN CODE 16, SAYING WHY.
